recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not lower ImagingStudy to FMM 4; handle the separate diagnostics-module narrative update under FHIR-57376 if that issue enters an eligible application scope.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ImagingStudy change request for R5, voted 3-0-0 on 2021-09-22, asking to update ImagingStudy maturity level to 4 after Connectathon 28 testing met the FMM 4 criteria.
initial_application: The request was applied in November 2021: commit 52a5df1794 changed source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml from FMM 3 to FMM 4, and commit 505bf71974 changed source/fhir.ini from imagingstudy=3 to imagingstudy=4.
additional_context: Applied R6 QA issue FHIR-53191 later directed ImagingStudy to standards-status normative and FMM 6; commits ec87b47603 and dd4c706d2d updated the StructureDefinition and fhir.ini. FHIR-50114 retracted a proposed FMM 5 change because the resource was being included in R6 core. FHIR-57376 now targets separate diagnostics-module roadmap prose that still says FMM=4, but it is only Resolved - change required and outside this applied/published seed scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active build configuration includes ImagingStudy and records imagingstudy=6, and the ImagingStudy StructureDefinition records standards-status normative and structuredefinition-fmm value 6, which satisfies and supersedes the older request to reach FMM 4.
